theme: one music family: low bowed cello and string drone, sparse felt piano, a slow soft heartbeat pulse
instrumental, sits quietly under a speaking voice

sections.name: The offer
styles: MUS-OFFER: confident steady pulse, held back so the words carry
warm strings and piano, the same family
audible from the very first second
carries straight on, never stops or goes silent

sections.name: Go and do your stairs
styles: MUS-OFFER: steady and resolved, a little fuller
lands on one warm held resolving chord
plays at a steady level right to the very end of the track, no fade, no silence
